featured_reviews.name: Geetu Gambhir (Geet)
featured_reviews.review_text:
I recently joined a yoga class, and honestly, I never really felt the urge to do so before. Maybe because, being trained in contemporary, ballet, and jazz, I already knew most of the movements and forms. But sometimes, your body needs support… you need guidance, a teacher, and a space where you can just slow down and be guided.

I was confused between joining yoga or going back to dance, but then I took a trial class in my society and met an incredibly dynamic woman, Kanika. The moment I attended her class, I instantly felt a connection. It felt like my search for the right person to guide me in yoga and help improve my body had finally come to an end.

It’s been a month now, and I can genuinely see changes in my body. Of course, it’s slow progress — there’s no magic in just one month — but the difference is real. I feel lighter, more confident, and more stable. After not dancing for years, I can finally say that my body feels aligned again.

Kanika is truly talented. She gives proper attention and focus to each of her students and teaches from the heart. She’s not someone who’s just trying to increase her client base. Even if there are just two or three people in a class, she gives her absolute best. She knows exactly what she’s doing, and there’s no rush in her approach — which is the most beautiful part of her teaching.

I would definitely recommend everyone to join her class.

Thank you so much 🤍

featured_reviews.review_text:
I first joined Prenatal Yoga with Ganesh Sir, and it truly helped me stay active throughout my pregnancy and even during recovery after delivery. The breathing exercises I learned became my biggest support during labor — they helped me stay calm and made the whole birthing process much smoother.

After delivery, I joined back again for postpartum recovery and to gradually return to my regular exercise routine. The sessions are designed to start from the very basics and progress to advanced levels. Both Radha Ma’am and Ganesh Sir explain everything so well — from why a particular exercise is done, when it should be done, its benefits, and even who should avoid it.

We practice many different types of yoga such as various asanas, Bhakti Yoga, Karma Yoga, and Krida Yoga, which keeps the sessions engaging and never boring. We also do Trataka, a cleansing practice for the eyes, which has really helped me improve my focus.

The breathing exercises have increased my lung capacity significantly — when I first joined, I could barely hold my breath for a few seconds, but now I can sustain it comfortably for much longer.

Another beautiful experience was music therapy conducted by Radha Ma’am. It helped me release emotions and brought a sense of peace and calm within.

The most valuable lesson I’ve learned through these sessions is how to manage my anxiety through breathing exercises.

A heartfelt thank you to Radha Ma’am and Ganesh Sir for their continuous support, guidance, and positive energy throughout my journey! 🙏
